description: This file implements a logging utility class 'Log' that provides static methods to facilitate logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility and manages a chain of LogNode objects for flexible log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to log messages at different levels, acting as a wrapper over Android's native Log class and a chainable LogNode interface.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode chain that receives log messages.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain for log message handling.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion-level message with optional Throwable.
